title: Identify European Firaga queued transfer source
changes: Add bounded feature-gated DMA read provenance and identify one original queued halfword-transfer projection and its two producer literals.
validation: Wine captures e326-firaga-40e844-dma-wine-d2e7v3m2 and e326-firaga-40e844-queue-wine-y_wimttr identify one DMA3 transfer and join a queued source-pointer write to its descriptor; a synthetic immediate-DMA pair preserves full state and guest clock.

Protected source plan e326-firaga-40e844-source-plan-yuq_1w_3 authenticates 264 unowned sampled bytes and original producer arithmetic, with Wine disassembly e326-firaga-enqueue-caller-wine-h4sr9ejw. Wine servers drained.
limitations: Only one selected transfer and continuation are covered; native exported PCs are context rather than exact store sites, and other indices, allocation/format, consumers, scenes, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance comparison was made.
The source-save history remains unknown. The nested DMA scope uses RAII but the focused synthetic check exercises immediate DMA only; typed publication is pending.
